why: Only checks duplicates followed by a different log (the working path); never a burst with no following log.
No CONSOLA_LEVEL check; only global logger, exports, shorthand methods.
Checks single-selection prompt with options A,B and initial B, confirm whether B starts selected; uncertainty notes initial is not passed.
No check of clicking an element inside an already selected element.
Uses opacity 0 but expects the buggy fallback 100 ('rather than the previous 0'), so the check would pass on the regression; flagged only as uncertainty.
Checks lock control hidden with zen on and shown when off, and visible/hidden controls in both states; explains hide class applied when visible is true.
No resize check of pasted charts; only paste content and labels.
Single selected element position check is generic, no line/arrow input.
No undo check; only font changes via container applying to bound text.
Check: pressing Escape with eraser active exits and restores previous tool.
Shortcut and arrow wrap checks do not set up missing parent element condition.
Rapid drag and pan checks, not window resize lag/flicker; explains animation-frame deferral.
Checks cover URL library import and confirmation but none opens the URL in a background tab to see the prompt appear before focus.
Pasting tab-separated cells with regular paste must still offer the spreadsheet dialog; names tabs converted to spaces before detection.
Check that choosing clear drawing opens confirmation and cancel/confirm work would fail on the broken dialog, though Ctrl+Delete shortcut is not used and store scoping is not named.
Checks bound-text editing height and wide text, but not editor width versus rendered width in Chrome; the 0.5px Firefox/Safari addition is only noted in key changes.
Icon check is generic (icons correspond to direction) with no Safari rendering/rotation check.
Add and follow ?a=1&b=2 link preserves both params, plus embed URL with & check; names new ampersand escaping.
Verify an eraser stroke across a locked object leaves it in the drawing.
Shortcut checks cover e and ArrowDown only; no crowfoot-one vs crowfoot-many shortcut check.
Check that the banner opens the destination appropriate to the signed-in or guest state; weak on exact URLs but exercises both states.
Drag-bound-endpoint checks target focus point/outside-shape cases; none drags an inside-bound endpoint and expects normal endpoint drag.
No check involves a rectangle containing a frame being added as a child on drag or box-selected; only partial-overlap and export checks.
Verify retrieval with _embed omitted still returns the requested resource; uses the triggering input though it does not name the extra undefined key.

Check starts the server with a file-path string database and reads a known record through existing data access; this fails when db.getState is missing. Key changes name async file access for file-path databases.
Checks cover default method, override and nested client defaults; none uses a custom fetch implementation or inspects the receiver.

Check with Content-Type application/vnd.example+json and a JSON body exercises the exact trigger and flags that it returns binary rather than parsed JSON (stated as expected, but the tester would see the blob); key changes say other content types return binary.

Check parses .env and reports extension .env with empty name, exercising the dotfile extname case and flagging the changed dotfile result; the expected value is the regressed behavior, so this is a weaker catch.
No check uses lowercase percent-encodings like %2f or %3f; %20 and %ZZ checks and raw-character encoding checks do not expose missing uppercase normalization.
Check serializes a query object with count: 0 and notes it produces count without =0; key changes name the numeric 0 behavior.
Checks remove base /app/ from /app and /app/item only; none uses an input whose remainder starts with a query such as /api?test.
